reason: `cardinality` was not dropped: it moved, together with the new `direction: "source" | "target"` discriminant, into the shared `EdgeCardinalityAxisRef` member of an intersection, and the type still carries it. The checker does not inventory type-reference bodies, so it reads the move as a removal and never sees the `direction` addition. The real change — the added `direction` discriminant on the claim params, the declaration and the contended row — is declared in .changeset/edge-kind-integrity.md under "Breaking changes".

`CommonOperationStrategy` is carried by the bundled engine profiles only: `strategy` is not a derivable profile key and `SqlEngineProfile.assembly` is sealed, so no external code authors or supplies one and a member change is not an authoring break (the type reads as author-facing but is not; see #672). `buildCountEdgesAtEndpoint` replaces `buildCountEdgesFrom` so the same builder counts either endpoint for target-side cardinality. Declared in .changeset/edge-kind-integrity.md.

`CommonOperationStrategy` is carried by the bundled engine profiles only: `strategy` is not a derivable profile key and `SqlEngineProfile.assembly` is sealed, so no external code authors or supplies one and a member change is not an authoring break (the type reads as author-facing but is not; see #672). `buildReadEdgeClaimIncumbents` reads the live incumbent on each composition axis after the batch claim lock, rendered from the same competing-live-edge predicate the single-row claim guard reads, so a batch claim over an attachment that holds no claim row refuses with the incumbent's id instead of attaching the part to a second whole. The composition claim it guards is declared in .changeset/composition.md.

`TransactionRuntime` is the `@internal`, symbol-keyed transaction runtime port; it is not exported from any entrypoint, so no external consumer can name or author one. It gains `reviveNode` so reopening a provenance fact's currency revives the node through the same owner that folds it back into its identity class. `TransactionRuntime` is the `@internal`, symbol-keyed transaction runtime port; it is not exported from any entrypoint, so no external consumer can name or author one. The checker reaches it contravariantly only because the transaction object itself appears in parameter position. The behavior is declared in .changeset/identity-write-path-consistency.md.

Callers obtain artifacts from the planners and pass them back unchanged; nobody authors one by hand. Formats 1 and 2 keep their own declarations and still parse for inspection; applying them is refused with UnsupportedMergePlanVersionError.

Declared in .changeset/sqlite-like-case-and-array-length.md.
